30130401.text: You're actually Nahida, aren't you! Paimon felt like Katheryne was acting weird when we met at the Sabzeruz Festival.

30130402.text: And Dunyarzad... Did you save her?

30130403.text: It's a really long story. We shouldn't disturb her. Her consciousness is still weakened.

30130404.text: Let's chat somewhere else. How about by the Traveler's favorite bench?

30130101.text: Let's talk about Dunyarzad first. It's such a relief that she's all right!

30130102.text: Hmm-hmm. After we parted on the last day of the Sabzeruz Festival, I left the city and saw what the Traveler had described.

30130103.text: Among the countless dreams, I found one that was growing fainter and fainter. This proved my suspicion.

30130104.text: Once Dunyarzad could no longer bear the Akasha harvesting her dreams, her consciousness began to dissipate — but this also meant it escaped the Akasha's control.

30130105.text: Such a small fragment of consciousness can't last for very long, though. It will return to its original dream...

30130106.text: Where both will gradually fade until they completely disappear.

30130107.text: I used all the power I had to keep her dying dream alive as long as possible, but it still wouldn't have lasted for much longer if it hadn't been for you two breaking the samsara.

30130108.text: So it looks like we did manage to save Dunyarzad in the end. And not a moment too soon!

30130111.text: Oh? Why are you two smiling so happily? I thought you'd be so moved that you'd start crying... Hmm... I need to spend more time observing human emotions.

30130112.text: Both are fine! Everyone reacts differently!

30130113.text: Alright, you two must have a lot of other questions for me, right? After all, you saved my faithful believer. As your reward, I'll answer any and all questions.

30130201.text: What's going on? Why are you two so excited to see me? Hehe, hasn't it only been a night?

30130202.text: It's actually been much longer than that...

30130203.text: Oh...? Strange, was I really asleep that long? No wonder I have such a headache...
